description: Electricity Infrastructure is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. The Electricity Infrastructure dataset presents the spatial locations of Power Lines, Substations and Major Power Stations within Australia. Power Lines are line data type, Substations and Major Power Stations are point data type. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are Australia, Electricity, Foundation Data, Geospatial, Infrastructure. It offers 2 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2026-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
